award_exclusion_limit_mixed_awards.description: Limit on the exclusion for the total cost of all employee achievement awards to one employee in a year when the employee receives both qualified plan and nonqualified awards.

supplemental_wages_withholding_threshold.description: Wages to an individual during the year above which the special rules for withholding federal income tax from supplemental wages apply (section 7 of Pub. 15).

social_security_wage_base_2026.description: Maximum wages subject to social security tax for 2026.
